name: 算邻坊AI能力 SuanLinFang
tagline: Speech-to-Text, TTS, OCR and LLM decision tools via one remote MCP server
description: Multi-capability remote MCP server (Streamable HTTP) from SuanLinFang (算邻坊), a GPU compute sharing platform. 11 tools: speech-to-text (long audio + hotword correction), text-to-speech (21 voices, long-text async tasks), OCR (images & PDF documents, standard/accurate tiers), and calibrated LLM decision scoring. Bring your own key — register at suanlinfang.cn to get an API key with free trial credit.

install.notes: Replace <YOUR_SLF_API_KEY> with your API key. Get one (with free trial credit) at https://suanlinfang.cn/consume-web/api-keys.html
